svg.title: s3ctl - no console clicking, no IAM drift
svg.desc: The s3ctl bucket mark drawn as a large dotted bucket with an amber keyhole, scanned from top to bottom, with the steps s3ctl runs: bucket, versioning, bucket policy, scoped key.

text.tspan: Buckets, versioning, policies and scoped keys from
flags, JSON or a CSV batch. --dry-run shows the plan first.
